-- 抽奖：全量计入（含未中奖、库存不足） SELECT d.member_name, d.create_time, 'DRAW' AS activity_type FROM t_draw_prize_log d JOIN t_activity_config a ON a.activity_code = d.activity_code WHERE d.create_time >= #{fromTime} AND a.status != 2
UNION ALL
-- 彩票：一注一行，靠外层 DISTINCT 收敛成人数 SELECT r.member_name, r.create_time, 'LOTTERY' AS activity_type FROM t_lottery_record r JOIN t_lottery_config c ON c.lottery_code = r.lottery_code JOIN t_activity_config a ON a.activity_code = c.activity_code WHERE r.create_time >= #{fromTime} AND r.member_name IS NOT NULL AND a.status != 2
UNION ALL
-- 任务：只算有效推进（flow_type = 1），被丢弃的事件不算参与 SELECT f.member_name, f.create_time, 'TASK' AS activity_type FROM t_task_record_flow f JOIN t_task_config tc ON tc.id = f.task_config_id JOIN t_activity_config a ON a.activity_code = tc.activity_code WHERE f.create_time >= #{fromTime} AND f.flow_type = 1 AND a.status != 2
